events.label: App started
events.description: A silent ping when the server boots in production.

events.label: Approval needed
events.description: A bot wants to run a tool that asks first.

events.label: Question asked
events.description: A bot asked you clarifying questions and is waiting.

events.label: Sign-in needed
events.description: A bot asked you to fill in a login it does not have.

events.label: Still waiting reminder
events.description: One reminder when an approval or question is still unanswered.

events.label: Bot messages
events.description: A bot messaged you while you were away, after work you didn't start yourself.

events.label: Routine messages
events.description: A quiet push with what a routine run messaged you. Runs with nothing to say send none.

events.label: Routine failed
events.description: A routine failed, was missed or was paused.

events.label: Reply failed
events.description: A bot's reply ended in a model error while you were away.

events.label: Long reply finished
events.description: A long-running reply finished while you were away.

events.label: Code updates
events.description: A coding agent's conversation you follow (Shelley, Claude Code) finished, failed or asked for you while you were away.

events.label: Auto-fix needs you
events.description: A pull request's Auto-fix stopped for your input, switched itself off at a limit, or a check stalled.

events.label: Pull request updates
events.description: A Code pull request's checks went green or failed (with Auto-fix off), or it merged.

events.label: Vault alerts
events.description: A vault value was revealed or an item deleted, or a bot was refused a fill.
